hints.text: Break the process into waits for the first new face, the second new face, and so on.
After k distinct faces have appeared, the chance the next roll is new is (8−k)/8.

solution.setup: Sum the geometric waiting times for successive new faces.
solution.reasoning: The expected waits are 1, 8/7, 8/6, ..., 8/1. Their sum is 8H8=8(1+1/2+...+1/8)=761/35.
solution.sanityCheck: The last missing face alone takes 8 rolls on average, so the total must substantially exceed 8.

keyInsight: Coupon collection decomposes into geometric stages with changing success probabilities.
recognitionCues: Repeated sampling continues until every category has appeared.
commonMistakes: Assuming eight faces require eight rolls on average.
followUps: What is the expected additional wait after seven faces have appeared?

source.notes: Original variant of a publicly reported interview family associated with Citadel Securities, Jump Trading.

title: Collect All Eight Faces
problem: Roll a fair eight-sided die repeatedly. What is the expected number of rolls required to see every face at least once?
